message:
I’ll never forget that one evening when the power went out unexpectedly. My husband and I were settling in for a cozy movie night, popcorn in hand, when—poof! Darkness. While he grumbled about the lack of cable, I felt a little spark of joy. 

I had my trusty flashlights ready, a lantern charged up, and even a power bank for our phones. I always joked about being ‘gloriously over-prepared,’ but there I was, the hero of the evening! We ended up playing board games by lantern light, laughing and chatting as if we were kids again. 

It’s funny how a little preparedness can turn a hiccup into a memorable night. How do you all stay comfy during a blackout? Any tips or tricks to share?
